resources.string: Share the radio packets your node hears with Prizm, the NodakMesh coverage dashboard. Uploads only happen in North Dakota and Minnesota, and only for packets heard while your phone has a good location fix.
Sign in with your Prizm account to turn uploads on.
Prizm sign-in is not live yet. This build uses a stand-in account and a stand-in uploader, so nothing leaves your phone.
Finish signing in in your browser, then come back here.
Uploading stops, your sign-in is revoked on Prizm and it is removed from this phone.
Send what your connected node hears. Runs in the background with a notification. Needs Share my location on.
Prizm only records packets that come with where you were. Turn this off and uploads pause: nothing is sent, not even without location. Privacy zones always apply.
Sign in before turning uploads on.
Uploading needs the notification and precise location permissions so it can keep running with the screen off.
Sharing your location needs the precise location permission.

Uploaded means accepted for upload. Metadata only is private traffic reduced to route and signal numbers. Not sent counts packets heard inside a privacy zone: nothing from them leaves the phone. Queued rows wait for the broker.
Inside a zone, or close enough that your phone cannot rule it out, nothing is uploaded: not the packets heard there and not your location.
Radius must be a number greater than 0.
Could not read your location. Check that location is on and allowed.

Only packets heard while Share my location is on and your phone has a good fix (accurate to about 50 m or better) inside North Dakota or Minnesota. Without a position Prizm discards a packet, so the app does not send it.
Adverts, traces, paths, acknowledgements and control packets, complete, because they are public by design.
Messages on the Public channel and on hashtag channels (names starting with #) that are set up on your node, complete.
Everything else (direct messages, requests, other channels) as route and signal numbers only: the packet header, route and path, SNR and RSSI. No message content.
Your location with every packet and health reading: position, accuracy, altitude, speed and bearing. Never from inside a privacy zone.
Node health every 5 minutes, with your position: battery voltage, uptime, noise floor, airtime and packet counts.
Your node public key, name, model, radio settings and firmware version, once you claim it.
The content of direct messages or of any channel that is not Public or a hashtag channel.
Your contacts, chats, drafts or phone data.
Your node private key, Bluetooth PIN or any password.
Anything heard inside a privacy zone, and anything at all while Share my location is off: uploads pause.
Anything heard while you are outside North Dakota and Minnesota (plus a 2 km margin). Nothing is held back and sent later.
This asks Prizm to erase everything uploaded from your account. It cannot be undone.
Prizm confirmed your data was deleted.
Deleting data is not available yet: this build has no Prizm deletion service. Ask the Prizm operators to delete your data.
Claim this node to your Prizm account?
How do you use this node?
Claiming. Your node signs a short message to prove it is yours.
This node is linked to another Prizm account (%1$s). Take it over?
The claim timed out. Try again.
The node could not sign. Check the connection and try again.
Heard %1$d, uploaded %2$d, metadata only %3$d, queued %4$d, not sent %5$d
